description: Spatial-interpolation queries over the zone/gridpoint fields: get scalar/vector/tensor values at arbitrary model-space points (not necessarily on gridpoints). This is the Python counterpart of the FISH zone.field.* family, but exposed as pure functions taking the field name and location per call (no persistent zone.field.name state to set). Signatures captured from live FLAC3D 9.7 docstrings (2026-08-13). Common optional kwargs (defaults): method='constant' (interpolation method), hide_null=False, fill_value=0.0, skip_init=False, radius_ratio=0.75, log=False, source='gridpoint', tolerance=1e-7.

functions.name: get
functions.signature: itasca.zone.field.get(name: str, location: vec, method='constant', hide_null=False, fill_value=0.0, skip_init=False, radius_ratio=0.75, log=False, source='gridpoint', quantity='norm', component='magnitude', tolerance=1e-7) -> float
functions.description: Get an interpolated value from the zones. 'name' is a zone field name (see the zone-field-data reference); tensor/vector fields are reduced via 'quantity'/'component'.

functions.name: get_scalar
functions.signature: itasca.zone.field.get_scalar(name: str, location: vec, ..., quantity='norm', component='magnitude', tolerance=1e-7) -> float
functions.description: Get an interpolated scalar value from the zones (same argument set as get()).

functions.name: get_vector
functions.signature: itasca.zone.field.get_vector(name: str, location: vec, ..., tolerance=1e-7) -> vec3
functions.description: Get an interpolated vector from the zones.

functions.name: get_tensor
functions.signature: itasca.zone.field.get_tensor(name: str, location: vec, ..., tolerance=1e-7) -> sten3
functions.description: Get an interpolated symmetric tensor from the zones.

functions.name: get_extra
functions.signature: itasca.zone.field.get_extra(extra: int, location: vec, ..., tolerance=1e-7) -> float
functions.description: Get an interpolated value from the gridpoint or zone extra variable at the given index.

functions.name: get_prop
functions.signature: itasca.zone.field.get_prop(prop: str, location: vec, ..., tolerance=1e-7) -> float
functions.description: Get an interpolated value of a mechanical (constitutive-model) property.

functions.name: get_prop_fluid
functions.signature: itasca.zone.field.get_prop_fluid(prop: str, location: vec, ..., tolerance=1e-7) -> float
functions.description: Get an interpolated value of a fluid property.

functions.name: get_prop_thermal
functions.signature: itasca.zone.field.get_prop_thermal(prop: str, location: vec, ..., tolerance=1e-7) -> float
functions.description: Get an interpolated value of a thermal property.

notes: All eight functions and their signatures verified against live FLAC3D 9.7 (__doc__ introspection).
The FISH-style stateful API (zone.field.name = ...; zone.field.get(pos)) documented in the fish-intrinsics/field-query reference is the FISH surface; the Python surface is stateless.
